title: Payment Arrangements Installment Terms Table
content:
Billing department table — installment terms of Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements).

| Tier | Most installments | Smallest installment | Installment schedule | Harvest installment month | First installment billed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Deferred Payment Agreement | 3 | $25.00 | monthly | 11 (November) | 1 billing period after acceptance |
| Extended Hardship Payment Agreement | 6 | $20.00 | monthly | 11 (November) | 1 billing period after acceptance |
| Winter Protection Payment Agreement | 6 | $20.00 | monthly | 11 (November) | 1 billing period after acceptance |
| Medical Certificate Payment Agreement | 6 | $20.00 | monthly | 11 (November) | 1 billing period after acceptance |
| Agricultural Harvest Payment Agreement | 1 | $250.00 | single harvest installment | 11 (November) | 1 billing period after acceptance |
| Commercial Installment Agreement | 2 | $100.00 | monthly | 11 (November) | 1 billing period after acceptance |

Terms common to every tier:

| Term | Value on every tier |
|---|---|
| Installment rounding | even split, last absorbs: each installment is the arranged amount divided by the count, rounded to the cent, and the last installment absorbs the cent difference |
| Charges not yet past due placed in the agreement | not allowed |
| Payment above the bill due | applied to the current charges, then to the next installment billed |

**Column definitions**

- *Most installments* is the largest number of installments the arranged amount may be spread over, a whole number.
- *Smallest installment* is the least amount of one installment in US dollars; the installment count is reduced until each installment reaches it.
- *Installment schedule*: monthly means one installment on each bill; single harvest installment means the whole arranged amount is billed on one harvest bill.
- *Harvest installment month* is the calendar month whose billing period carries the single harvest installment. Every tier lists month 11, and only the single harvest installment schedule uses it.
- *First installment billed* counts billing periods after acceptance; 1 means the next bill.

**Illustration (hypothetical arranged amount of $100.00 on a three-installment count)** — $100.00 divided by 3 is 33.333…, rounded to the cent $33.33 for the first and second installments; the last installment absorbs the difference and is $33.34.
